components.reason: Language: negation/implication fragment, defined as formulas built from variables by negation and implication alone (setting lines 35-38; sheet line 7; definition line 15). Axiom schemas A1-A3 and MP: displayed on the sheet (lines 8-11, rendered at classical-and-constructive-calculi.tex line 160) and restated in Part 2 (w02b-p02-010 lines 90-95). Assumption convention: a derivation from Gamma is a finite sequence each of whose members is in Gamma, an axiom instance or an MP consequence of two earlier members (definition lines 16-21; sheet line 7); a member of Gamma may be written at any line and MP has no side condition (w02b-p02-010 lines 95-97); H-theorem = derivable from the empty set (line 45).

Statement for every set Gamma (no finiteness restriction) and all fragment formulas phi, psi, both directions (body lines 26-34). Written proof (annex lines 2-43): right-to-left by monotonicity plus one MP step; left-to-right by induction on the lines of a derivation from Gamma plus phi, with every licensing case written (member of Gamma or axiom instance via A1 and MP; the line phi itself via the displayed A1/A2 derivation of phi -> phi; MP lines via the A2 instance and two MP steps). Premise scope and the reason it holds (MP the only rule; uniform substitution only instantiates schemas, never premises) are stated on the sheet (lines 25-27) and in Part 2 (lines 95-99).

components.gap: Give both-direction translations/equivalence and an explicit comparison with the selected ND and LK presentations under the declared mathematical conventions. The selected ND presentation (sheet:nd-cpl, handbook/registry/calculi/nd-cpl.tex line 16 and rows 23, 24, 26, 29; inherited derivation definition, handbook/restoration/inherited-02193-02340.tex lines 14-27) discharges exactly the open occurrences marked with the application's label, which may be some but not all open occurrences of the formula, an unmarked occurrence staying open. The translation section instead declares that every discharge 'applies to all open occurrences of its formula' (axiomatic-calculi-analytic-tableaux-and-refutation-w02b-p02-010.tex lines 46-49); its ND-to-Hilbert proof rests on 'the sheet discharges every open occurrence of the discharged formula' and computes oa(D) = Gamma_1 minus {alpha} and the analogous equalities for the or-elimination, negation-introduction and RAA cases (annex lines 448-452, 466-496), which do not hold for sheet:nd-cpl derivations that leave a marked-elsewhere or unmarked occurrence open; the composition step used for Corollary thm:p02-w02b-p02-010-hilbert-equivalence(1) right to left (annex lines 256-271, 632-638) re-applies each discharge 'to the same occurrences' after grafting, which presupposes the labelled convention and contradicts the declared all-occurrence convention; and the comparison's failure case def:p02-w02b-p02-010-vacuous (body lines 377-391) asserts that the padding detour fails for P -> (P -> P) because 'the inner ->I discharges every open occurrence of P', which is false for sheet:nd-cpl, where the two assumption occurrences can carry distinct labels. As written, the ND-to-Hilbert map and the ND leg of the equivalence are established only for a narrower class of derivations than the selected presentation's, and the comparison misstates the selected presentation. State the setting, the ND-to-Hilbert case computations and the failure case under the sheet's labelled-discharge convention. In addition, item 3 of def:p02-w02b-p02-010-setting (lines 56-61) identifies the LK_CPL rules with 'the propositional rows of sheet:lk', which include the Mix row (handbook/registry/calculi/lk.tex line 30), while the LK-to-Hilbert proof (annex lines 591-593) and annex:p7.calculi.3 give no Mix case: give that case or state the LK_CPL rule set exactly.

defect_observations: Discharge-convention conflict (basis of the GOAL-03 gap): w02b-p02-010 body lines 46-49 and annex lines 448-452 describe sheet:nd-cpl as discharging every open occurrence of the discharged formula; nd-cpl.tex line 16 says the discharged occurrences 'may be some but not all of the open occurrences', and rows 23, 24, 26 and 29 say an unmarked occurrence stays open. The H-to-ND annex (lines 363-365, 376-378) also argues by open occurrences rather than labels; its conclusions still hold for the labelled convention.

def:p02-w02b-p02-010-vacuous (body lines 377-391) and the method's side condition (lines 314-316) present the A1 case split for phi = psi as necessary; for sheet:nd-cpl the ordinary padding detour with two distinct labels already gives a derivation of P -> (P -> P), so the stated failure case does not arise for the selected presentation.

Item 3 of def:p02-w02b-p02-010-setting equates the inherited LK_CPL rules (restoration/inherited-02341-02450.tex lines 41-99, which have no Mix) with 'the propositional rows of sheet:lk', which add the Mix row (lk.tex line 30, described at line 6 as a Cut-equivalent derived convenience). annex:p7.calculi.3 says it 'exhausts all rules of equality-free sheet:lk' without a Mix case.
